journey.name: Hardware Wallet USB Reconnect
journey.description: Verifies the disconnect indicator and the USB-attach auto-reconnect chain by injecting the OS attach intent, with the Bridge emulator standing in for the transport. Covers MainActivity intent handling, the serialized reconnect retry loop, and the prompt-free reconnect. Requires a paired Bridge emulator (run connect-home-tile.xml first).

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app, open the menu, navigate to Settings, then Dev Settings, then tap the "Trezor" row
Verify the connected device is shown, then tap the "Disconnect" button
Navigate back to the wallet home screen
Verify the hardware wallet tile still shows its name and balance but the connection indicator icon is grey
adb: adb shell am start -a android.hardware.usb.action.USB_DEVICE_ATTACHED -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity
Verify the app comes to the foreground on the wallet home screen
Verify the hardware tile connection indicator turns green within 15 seconds, with no PIN or pairing prompt shown
